description: This file defines a class 'Custom_MCP' implementing an MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool node, including methods for loading actions, initializing, and retrieving tools with variable substitution and caching. It handles MCP server configuration, variable parsing, and security validation.

classes.name: Custom_MCP
classes.description: A class representing a custom MCP tool node with methods for configuration, action listing, and tool retrieval.

methods.name: loadMethods
methods.description: Contains method 'listActions' to asynchronously list available actions for the MCP tool.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the MCP tool with selected actions based on node data and options.

methods.name: getTools
methods.description: Retrieves tools from MCP server configuration, performing variable substitution, caching, and validation.
